content.intro: {state} charges {stateRate} state sales tax plus local tax, then a registration fee and an age-based uniform fee every year.

howItWorks.text: Every combined rate on the Tax Commission's list includes the state rate. Local rates are added on top.
A trade-in that is part of the same sale comes off the amount taxed.
Instead of property tax, most passenger vehicles pay a uniform fee set by model year. Newer vehicles pay more.
A driver education fee and an uninsured motorist identification fee are added to each registration.

faq.q: Which local rate applies when I buy from a {state} dealer?
faq.text: The Tax Commission sources a retail sale made in the state to the seller's place of business, so the rate where the dealer is applies.

faq.q: Does {state} give credit for tax paid in another state?
faq.text: Yes. The Tax Commission allows credit for tax properly due and paid first to another state.
